title: Per-agent rate limit on /mcp
body:
A misbehaving worker sent 40k tool calls in ten minutes. Add a per-agent rate limit to the MCP endpoint.

- Token bucket per agent id, configured with SUBSPACE_MCP_RATE (calls per minute, default 600) and SUBSPACE_MCP_BURST (default 60).
- Over the limit the call fails with JSON-RPC error code `rate_limited` and a retry_after hint; heartbeat is exempt.
- Export a `subspace_mcp_rate_limited_total` counter labelled by agent role on /metrics.
- A tester writes a deterministic simulation test with a fake clock that proves the limit and the heartbeat exemption.

repos.name: SigmaUno/subspace
repos.description: Go server; internal/ratelimit has a token bucket, internal/metrics the Prometheus registry

requirements.title: Rate limit MCP calls per agent with a token bucket
Simulation test for the MCP rate limit with a fake clock
